Happy, happy news today!!! Lorna’s NMC PIN has come through and she is officially a registered nurse in the UK!!! 🎉🙏❤️

Lorna Villaruz, after all these years of me telling you to come to Liverpool, you’re finally coming! Twenty years of “you should come here” and now it’s really happening 😂 I’m so proud of you and so happy I can hardly type properly!

We go all the way back to nursing school in Iloilo and our capping ceremony in 1996. Look at us in those old photos, polishing our white shoes every night in the dorm. And Lorna, you always borrowed my shoe polish and never bought your own! Some things never change 😂

Then I left for the UK in 2004, and you cried at the airport and said, “Susunod ako” — I’ll follow you. Well, here we are, 22 years later, and you’re on your way! From Riyadh to Dubai, after almost 18 years of hard work, and now a new chapter in Liverpool. You even did your OSCE in Nottingham, and I sent you a photo of our rain so you’d know exactly what you’re getting into ☔️😂

Your flight lands at Manchester on 14 January, around 1pm, and you start at Mersey Bank Hospital on 25 January. Ward 7 is so lucky to have you. You are the best nurse I know: calm, kind, and loved by your patients. They’re going to be in such good hands.

And yes, you’ll be staying with us for your first month — Ben says it’s okay, and we’re looking forward to having you here! Bring those dried mangoes and the Bicol pili for Tito Ben, and please bring a proper coat too. Liverpool wind is no joke, my friend! 😂

Welcome to Liverpool, welcome to our Filipino family here, and welcome to this next adventure. There’ll be Christmas parties, plenty of food and laughter, and Simbang Gabi with us next year. We can’t wait to celebrate with you and make you feel at home.

So proud of you, Lorna. Safe travels when the day comes — we’ll be waiting for you! ❤️🎉
